title: Gradius Deluxe Pack
native_title: グラディウス ＤＥＬＵＸＥ ＰＡＣＫ
overview:
Shooting Masterpieces That Live On in Gaming History, "Gradius" and "Gradius II," Return in a Deluxe Pack!

To protect planet Gradius, launch, Vic Viper! That excitement, that emotion, now revived across time and space.

The Bacterian Empire is attacking the planet Gradius, and its last hope is the space fighter Vic Viper. Fly through side-scrolling stages, destroy enemy waves and pick up power capsules, then choose your upgrades from the power meter - speed, missiles, double shot, laser, trailing and options that copy your fire.

- Gradius: six stages leading to the heart of the enemy fortress
- Gradius II - Gofer no Yabou: pick a weapon set and shield type before you launch, and face high-speed stages and a gauntlet of bosses
- One player, or two players taking turns

ゲーム史に残るシューティングの傑作「グラディウス」「グラディウスII」がデラックスパックで復活!

惑星グラディウスを守るため、出動せよビックバイパー!
あの興奮、あの感動が時空を越えて今、甦る。
